metric_policy.layout: Exactly one chronological Markdown table containing every recorded recurrence; append each future row to it. The final row must contain the latest measurements and Promotion forecast. Additional detail belongs in prose or linked evidence, not separate tables.
metric_policy.authorization: The author requires relevant progress metrics and a visible promotion forecast with candidate/event scope. The October 14 clarification distinguishes the broad program from F01; dated carries and new unassessed targets are explicit.
metric_policy.columns: Keep several useful active metrics and Promotion forecast; add/replace/retire metrics with explicit definitions and scopes, retaining historical series.
metric_policy.deltas: Use changes from the latest actual comparable measurement; first entries and carries have null deltas. Within-hour changes are not recurrence changes. Preserve adverse or zero actual changes.
metric_policy.missing: Carry an unremeasured relevant value with original source/hash/UTC, observed_in_row, age_in_recurrences, carried_in_row and reason; never present it as a new run or fake zero change.
metric_policy.age_definition: Count later rows in this recorded-boundary series, including historic checkpoints/tails/excluded attempts; not elapsed hours.
metric_policy.selection: Use the latest completed supported implementation, not a more favorable intermediate version. Retained control records keep their own actual dates.
metric_policy.scopes: Bind source, ordered duty, tolerance, initial evidence, menu, caps and tariff; an outer source/request hash alone is insufficient.
metric_policy.forecast: For a new assessment retain the exact event and report estimate, range, rationale, risks and comparable changes. Otherwise carry its original date, event and assessment without claiming a new measurement. A different claim starts a separate series and may remain UNASSESSED. Never reconstruct old probabilities.
metric_policy.cost: Keep named bills, action costs, acquisitions, host resources and unknown fees distinct. Zero demonstrated benefit regions means none established, not universal impossibility.
metric_policy.historical_numbers: Earlier one-off findings remain scoped history. Family/test/file/time counts are not readiness measures.
